verdict.rationale: Reducto accepts natural language inside several of its own endpoints: Edit takes natural-language instructions, and Split and Classify take sections and categories described in natural language. Its official MCP server also lets agents in Claude, Cursor and similar clients drive classify, parse, extract, split and edit from conversational requests. However, these natural-language inputs are parameters of programmatic API calls, and full conversational control depends on an external agent host. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for operating the product end-to-end, natural-language control of Parse/Extract configuration (Extract requires a schema), independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions.
You describe sections in natural language, and Reducto returns the page numbers where each section lives.
You specify categories with natural language criteria, and Reducto returns the best match.

agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any other Model Context Protocol client can classify, parse, extract, split, and edit documents as part of their reasoning loop, without custom integration code.
